subject: Money
title: The Gini Coefficient
description: A quick win: understand The Gini Coefficient.

hook.text: South Africa's Gini coefficient is 0.63—the highest on Earth. Denmark's is 0.28. One number captures the gap.

buildup.text: The Gini coefficient measures inequality from 0 (perfect equality) to 1 (one person owns everything).

discovery.text: The U.S. Gini is 0.39—higher than any other developed nation. It's been rising since the 1980s.

twist.text: China's Gini went from 0.30 in 1980 to 0.47 in 2023. Rapid growth created rapid inequality simultaneously.

climax.text: Gini is imperfect—it doesn't show where the inequality is concentrated. But it's the best single number we have.

punchline.text: One number. A society's report card.

quiz.question: What does a Gini coefficient of 0 represent?
